modules.summary: Public orchestration for the Section 01 generator.
Run the canonical Spark batch pipeline and collect its evidence summary.
Resolve the deployable Flink runtime settings used by streaming jobs.
Declare the supported Airflow DAG inventory and scheduling contracts.
Emit the deployable DataHub lineage and metadata contracts for platform assets.
Apply the deployable Pinot schema and table assets and record their status.
Map deployable data-quality layer outcomes to orchestration gate behavior.

symbols.name: GenerationResult
symbols.summary: Return generated roots, row counts, and evidence paths from one generator run.

symbols.name: run_generation
symbols.summary: Generate the selected source modes and return their persisted evidence locations.

symbols.name: run_batch_pipeline
symbols.summary: Run Spark, dbt, parity, Trino, and export steps for one batch window.

symbols.name: RuntimeSettings
symbols.summary: Expose Kafka, MinIO, checkpoint, and output settings for a Flink job.

symbols.name: load_runtime_settings
symbols.summary: Load environment overrides with pipeline-config defaults for a Flink run.

symbols.name: DagSpec
symbols.summary: Describe one deployable DAG's ID, schedule, window support, and monitoring role.

symbols.name: dag_specs_by_id

symbols.name: DataHubLineageEmitter
